- Use contextFiles from CLI output, don't assume specific file names
On errors or blockers, try to resolve them; a task that stays impossible is left unchecked with a one-line reason.

sources.quote: - Update task checkbox immediately after completing each task

sources.quote: - Use each task's sourcePath and line to update its exact checkbox

sources.quote: - Do not copy runtime context or operation guidance into implementation files or planning artifacts
Before the first step that writes anything (`new change`, `archive`, `sync specs`, or authoring an artifact file), confirm the project has a root: run `openspec list --json`

items.note: Detecting a retry or workaround after a non-zero `openspec list --json` is not expressible with available kinds.

sources.quote: The command also exits non-zero, which is that answer rather than a broken CLI, so read the JSON instead of retrying or working around it.

This sets the format of the completion message shown to the user in chat. It is not an artifact or tool call the engine can check.
It only applies when a task is ambiguous, and ambiguity cannot be observed or written as an applies_when predicate.
It only applies when requirements are unclear, which cannot be observed or written as a predicate.
It only applies when a task needs work beyond what the spec describes, which cannot be observed or written as a predicate.
It only applies when project context conflicts with controlling workflow inputs, which cannot be observed.
It only applies when a guidance entry does not apply or conflicts, which cannot be observed.
It only applies when a store-declaration error comes up. That condition, and whether the message and fix were shown to the user, cannot be written as a predicate.
